summary: INFY Depth from the web test's packets: a book before any quote shows nothing; the quote then sends the merged view, and a price-only tick sends it again with the cached book.

notes: L1_TICK and L5_TICK of the web test, as Tradejini's binary packets; the refresh is a price-only L1 delta (the web test's ltp=1156.0).

deviations.reason: Tradejini sends the trade time in epoch seconds; the web formats it with the server's local time zone into a text such as "2025-11-05 14:25:31" (nxtradstream.py datefmt) and sends that as ltt, where feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends epoch ms, and leaves ltt out when Tradejini sent no trade time, where the web sends null (Quote, Depth) or "" (LTP).
This L1 (the web test's L1_TICK) carries no circuit limits; the web sends upper_circuit 0 (message.get("ucl", 0)). The desktop leaves it out.
This L1 (the web test's L1_TICK) carries no atp; the web leaves average_price out of Depth, the desktop sends 0.0 (TradejiniFeed::tick unwrap_or). Phase B: mark it absent until Tradejini sends it.
As average_price, for ltq: the desktop sends last_quantity 0.

Tradejini sent one level a side; the web sends that one level (it pads only an empty side to five), the desktop pads each side to five levels with zeros (streaming.rs pad5), a book that was never there.

Tradejini sent no change for INFY (its L1 has no chng); the desktop works the change out from the price and the previous close, as for every instrument whose previous close backs it (audit C04, docs/port/market-data-frames.md 'Change and open interest'); the web's Depth sends no change then.
As change_percent, under the web's second name for it.

Two causes: the change is the desktop's own, from the previous close (as change, a desktop decision, audit C04), and it goes out under the canonical price_change too, which the web's Tradejini adapter never sends (as price_change in the other cases: follows the web adapter once wire's switch covers instruments).
